skill_name: Explain the concept of Mitochondrial Eve.
workflow: Mitochondrial Eve is the name given to the most recent common ancestor of all living humans. It is believed that she lived around 200,000 years ago and her mitochondrial DNA has been passed down to every human in the world today. Mitochondrial Eve is a genetic universal ancestor, meaning that her mitochondrial DNA was passed down to everyone, regardless of language or culture.
